description: Stephanie Morris reaches out to Betty Kowalski for a direct conversation — coffee or phone call — prior to Betty's city council testimony. Stephanie shares updated market analysis framing on auto row property value trends; Betty shares ground-level intelligence on foot traffic, owner sentiment, and what neighboring businesses are saying about their timelines. Stephanie also signals that she is a resource for any auto row owner considering their options.

resources.detail: Mutual intelligence exchange — no money changes hands. Stephanie offers market expertise and credibility; Betty offers community intelligence and potential referral network access.

expected_outcome: Strengthened trust with Betty Kowalski (currently 0.57). Advance intelligence on auto row business owner sentiment before council testimony. Possible warm referral to one or more auto row property owners weighing exit or repositioning decisions.
contingency: If Betty declines or is unavailable, Stephanie notes the attempt and follows up post-testimony using Betty's public council record as a conversation opener.
